<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
<title>Pythagoras' theorem</title>
<style>
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:0.35}50%{opacity:0.9}}
.c{animation:pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.ab{animation:pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:1.5s}
</style>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#fff"/>
<g transform="translate(-140,0)">
<rect x="180" y="200" width="120" height="120" fill="#1f77b4" class="ab" stroke="#0b3d63" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="300" y="320" width="160" height="160" fill="#2ca02c" class="ab" stroke="#14591a" stroke-width="2"/>
<polygon points="300,200 460,320 580,160 420,40" fill="#d62728" class="c" stroke="#7f1213" stroke-width="2"/>
<polygon points="300,200 460,320 300,320" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="300" y="300" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240" y="268" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">a²</text>
<text x="380" y="408" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">b²</text>
<text x="440" y="180" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">c²</text>
<text x="285" y="265" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#000" text-anchor="end">a</text>
<text x="380" y="336" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#000" text-anchor="middle">b</text>
<text x="390" y="250" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#000">c</text>
</g>
<text x="460" y="90" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">Pythagoras' theorem</text>
<text x="460" y="260" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">a² + b² = c²</text>
<text x="460" y="300" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#d62728">c = hypotenuse</text>
<text x="460" y="325" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">(longest side)</text>
<text x="460" y="360" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">Right angle opposite c</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
<title>Series circuit</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="400" y="40" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000">Series circuit: one loop</text>
<path id="loop" d="M200 150 H600 V350 H200 Z" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
<!-- cell on left -->
<rect x="170" y="215" width="60" height="70" fill="#fff"/>
<line x1="180" y1="230" x2="220" y2="230" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="190" y1="270" x2="210" y2="270" stroke="#000" stroke-width="8"/>
<text x="160" y="255" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="end" fill="#000">Cell</text>
<text x="240" y="225" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#c00">+</text>
<text x="240" y="285" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#000">−</text>
<!-- bulb 1 top -->
<rect x="320" y="130" width="80" height="40" fill="#fff"/>
<circle cx="360" cy="150" r="24" fill="#fff8c0" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
<path d="M346 164 L355 138 L365 162 L374 138" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="360" y="108" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000">Bulb 1</text>
<!-- resistor right -->
<rect x="570" y="215" width="60" height="70" fill="#fff"/>
<rect x="580" y="220" width="40" height="60" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="640" y="255" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#000">Resistor</text>
<!-- bulb 2 bottom -->
<rect x="420" y="330" width="80" height="40" fill="#fff"/>
<circle cx="460" cy="350" r="24" fill="#fff8c0" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
<path d="M446 364 L455 338 L465 362 L474 338" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="460" y="406" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000">Bulb 2</text>
<!-- current dots -->
<circle r="8" fill="#d00"><animateMotion dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M200 150 H600 V350 H200 Z"/></circle>
<circle r="8" fill="#d00"><animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-3s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M200 150 H600 V350 H200 Z"/></circle>
<text x="400" y="460" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#d00">Current is the same everywhere in the loop</text>
<text x="400" y="255" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#00569e">Voltage of the cell is shared</text>
<text x="400" y="280" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#00569e">between the components</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
<title>Photosynthesis</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<style>
.t{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:18px;fill:#111}
.b{font-weight:bold}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.3}50%{opacity:1}}
.ray{animation:pulse 2s infinite}
</style>
<text class="t b" x="400" y="40" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">Photosynthesis in a leaf</text>

<circle cx="90" cy="100" r="35" fill="#f9c80e" stroke="#b58900" stroke-width="3"/>
<g class="ray" stroke="#e08a00" stroke-width="5">
<line x1="125" y1="125" x2="205" y2="185"/>
<line x1="140" y1="95" x2="230" y2="150"/>
<line x1="110" y1="140" x2="180" y2="215"/>
</g>
<text class="t" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="40" y="165">Light energy</text>

<path d="M280 280 Q400 150 560 250 Q400 370 280 280 Z" fill="#2e9e44" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="290" y1="280" x2="550" y2="250" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="3"/>
<ellipse cx="400" cy="250" rx="28" ry="16" fill="#14532d"/>
<text class="t" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="400" y="256" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#fff">chlorophyll</text>
<text class="t b" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="420" y="320" text-anchor="middle">Chloroplast in leaf</text>

<text class="t b" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="40" y="400">Carbon dioxide</text>
<text class="t" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="40" y="422">(CO₂) in</text>
<g transform="translate(60,370)"><circle r="8" fill="#555">
<animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M0 0 L220 -90"/>
<animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle></g>

<text class="t b" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="400" y="470" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#1d4ed8">Water (H₂O) from roots</text>
<line x1="400" y1="445" x2="400" y2="375" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="5"/>
<circle cx="400" cy="440" r="7" fill="#1d4ed8">
<animate attributeName="cy" values="440;380" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
</circle>

<text class="t b" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="780" y="130" text-anchor="end">Oxygen (O₂) out</text>
<circle cx="600" cy="230" r="9" fill="#fff" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="3">
<animate attributeName="cx" values="580;700" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
<animate attributeName="cy" values="230;150" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
</circle>

<text class="t b" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="780" y="330" text-anchor="end">Glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆)</text>
<text class="t" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="780" y="354" text-anchor="end">made and stored</text>
<polygon points="680,270 700,258 720,270 720,292 700,304 680,292" fill="#f4a261" stroke="#7a3e00" stroke-width="3"/>

<text class="t" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" x="600" y="440" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">CO₂ + H₂O → glucose + O₂</text>
</svg>
